title: I think Goodfellas has the best voiceover I’ve ever heard in a movie, but I can’t figure out why

commenti.body: It's not just a device for lazy exposition as voiceovers often can be. It gives us Henry's point of view on what we're seeing and there's often interesting interplay or tension between the images or actions shown and the words we're hearing.

Huge part of it is definitely Ray Liotta’s voice and his laidback way of telling the story with humor and insight. 

Another classic voiceover I feel is Apocalypse Now which I enjoy a lot.

Yeah, it isn’t just there for exposition. It gives you an insight into these characters, and the world they live in. It creates a dichotomy between action and inner dialogue.

Also, the pace of it really adds to the films kinetic energy.
Love the one in Apocalypse Now
